market_question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Ethereum has historically experienced drawdowns exceeding 30% within similar time windows. Given typical crypto volatility and the 13-month observation period, a touch of $1,500 is more likely than not, even from relatively moderate starting levels. The market's 43.5% implied probability appears to underestimate this tail risk.
evidence_points: ETH dropped over 80% from its 2021 ATH to the 2022 low, showing how quickly major drawdowns occur.
A one-year window (Nov 2025–Dec 2026) provides ample time for a 25–30% correction from recent $2,000 levels.
The resolution condition requires only a single 1-minute low ≤$1,500, not a sustained break, making the event easier to trigger.
sources_consulted: Crypto market cycle patterns (post-halving bear phases)
